g.text: RF-PID-101 REV B · ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD) · REV A SCREEN SHEET REMAINS THE OTS REFERENCE
C3= VAPOUR −40 °C TO V-201 SUCTION DRUM
C2= VAPOUR −101 °C TO V-301 SUCTION DRUM
CLASS: A3 CS 300# · L3 LTCS 300# (MDMT −46 °C) · S3 SS304L 300#
(MDMT −196 °C) · A1 CS 150# · CI COLD INSUL. · PP PERS. PROT.
1. DESIGN BASIS (OTS TEACHING CASE): DRY FEED 2000 kmol/h, H2 15 / CH4 30 / C2H4 40 / C2H6 13 / C3H6 2 mol %, 15 °C, 33 BAR A. OTS MODEL, NOT PLANT DATA.
2. KETTLES: GAS IN TUBES, REFRIGERANT BOILS IN SHELL; LEVEL SETS WETTED AREA. SHELLS RELIEVE VIA SUCTION HEADERS (PSV-201 / PSV-301), NO VALVE IN VAPOUR OUTLET (TBC).
3. COLD SERVICE: E-101 / V-101 LTCS (MDMT −46 °C); E-102 / V-102 / OFF-GAS SS 304L. CI = COLD INSULATION + VAPOUR BARRIER. DRAINS / VENTS TO CLOSED SYSTEMS.
4. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (GAS ≤ 12 m/s, LIQUID ≤ 1.5 m/s, 2-PHASE ON INLET VAPOUR). PSV-116 / PSV-117 SETS AND LV-105 / LV-110 BYPASSES TBC.
5. REV B ADDS: BL MARK, FV-101 BLOCK/BYPASS, LV BLOCK VALVES, LV-103 / LV-108 BYPASSES, PV-112 BLOCKS, DRAINS, VENTS, LINE CLASSES.
A. TIC-102 → LIC-103 SP (20–80 %) → LV-103 (FC): GAS OUT OF E-101 HELD AT −35 °C BY THE WETTED BUNDLE AREA.
B. TIC-107 → LIC-108 SP (20–80 %) → LV-108 (FC): GAS OUT OF E-102 HELD AT −97 °C; SETS C2H4 LOSS IN OFF-GAS (AI-114).
C. PIC-112 → PV-112 (FO) HOLDS 32.5 BAR A; LIC-105 / LIC-110 → LV-105 / LV-110 (FC) TO THE DEMETHANIZER.
D. FIC-101 → FV-101 (FC): FEED RATE SET BY THE CRACKED-GAS SECTION. XV-100 (FC, SIS) UPSTREAM OF THE CHILLERS.
E. KETTLE LEVEL > 88 % CARRIES LIQUID TO THE SUCTION DRUM → LSHH-202 / LSHH-302 (RF-PID-201 / 301).
